feeds.title: Burn The Fat Blog
feeds.description: Tom Venuto is a fat loss coach, fitness writer, and best-selling author of Burn the Fat, Feed the Muscle known by fans as The Bible of Fat Loss. Through this blog, along with his books, community (inner circle), and fitness challenge contests, his goal is to inform and inspire you to reach your body transformation goals at any age, without fads, gimmicks, pills, potions, or any quick fixes.

feeds.title: Obesity Health Alliance Blog
feeds.description: Covers food marketing restrictions, nutrient profiling models, childhood obesity, sugar awareness, and practical solutions to maintain a healthy weight. The Obesity Health Alliance is a coalition of over 40 organizations working together to reduce obesity by influencing Government policy.

feeds.title: Living 400lbs
feeds.description: A very personal blog documenting what it's like to weigh ~400lbs. Blog topics cover anti-fat bigotry, anti-obesity programs, childhood obesity, co-opting fat acceptance, dieting, exercise, yoga, fat panic, size-positive art, and statistics.

feeds.title: Dr. Sharma's Obesity Notes
feeds.description: Views and news on obesity research and management.Dr. Arya M. Sharma, is a Professor of Medicine & Chair in Obesity Research and Management at the University of Alberta, Edmonton, Canada. His research focuses on the evidence-based prevention and management of obesity and its complications.
